facts.summary: Missed primary 6-minute walk endpoint at Month 12 · Phase 3 · acoramidis in ATTR-CM · not yet approved

evidence.summary: ATTRibute-CM did not meet its primary endpoint at Month 12.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: In the primary analysis, change from baseline in 6MWD was not improved in the acoramidis arm relative to the placebo arm (p = 0.76)
evidence.safety: Acoramidis was generally well-tolerated with no safety signals of clinical concern identified.
evidence.program_discontinued: The ATTRibute-CM independent data monitoring committee recommends continuing the study based on unblinded data reviews.
